beforePublishing.message: Replace or remove each term below before publishing. This version of the scan reports the terms only: it does not block publication.

notFramed.title: Listings not included
notFramed.message: Content that listings and other components fetch from elsewhere is read only when the scan runs from Page Builder. Open the page in Page Builder to include it.

truncated.title: Scan stopped at its limit
truncated.message: The page holds more content or issues than one scan reads. Fix the issues listed, then scan again.

origin.sharedHint: Stored outside this page (a listing, for one) and shown on other pages too; it is published on its own.
origin.sharedAreaHint: Stored on the page {{path}} (header, footer) and shown on this page and others; it is published with that page.
